claim_summary: Plan ARIA-V5 — Adversarial Convergence Gates + Pedagogy Universalization. The autonomy orchestrator runs planner_drainer + worker_drainer + auto_merge unconditionally with no primary↔challenger convergence gate and no post-implementation adversarial review. Operator vision (2026-05-16): every plan must be reviewed continuously with two agents debating back-and-forth until validation is complete, and after implementation agents must again check for gaps. V5 wires the existing plan_convergence (1479 LOC) + convergent_planning_bridge (119 LOC) infrastructure into the runtime so Gate A (pre-worker convergence) gates worker_drainer, Gate B (post-impl review) gates auto_merge_runner. Pedagogy universalization extends V4's pedagogy-tier discipline from 9 ARIA agents to all 81 agents (72 newly tiered + 8 V4 ARIA agents). All 4 subfindings closed across 5 commits on snowball.

v5_resolution_summary: Plan ARIA-V5 CONVERGED — all 4 subfindings RESOLVED. Architectural arc complete: autonomy orchestrator now runs cycle_runner → planner_drainer → bridge_drainer → convergence_runner (Gate A) → worker_drainer → review_runner (Gate B) → auto_merge_runner (gated) → reflection (schema v2 with convergence + pedagogy sub-objects). 16 V5 invariants pin the contract: I-V5-01/02 (Tier-1 required kwarg signature), I-V5.1-02..05 (convergence ordering + verdict gating + max_rounds blocked transition), I-V5.2-02..05 (review ordering + non-pass verdicts + source-substring guard + blocked_merge transition), I-V5.3-01..03 (pedagogy frontmatter + lint warn-mode + CLI exit/JSON), I-V5.4-01..03 (reflection v2 schema + null sentinel + daily report rendering). CI workflows (aria-kernel.yml + aria-kernel-fast.yml + aria-kernel-full.yml) run pedagogy_lint in warn mode; --strict flip is a future commit once allowlist is empty.

ReviewRunner Protocol + ReviewResult TypedDict + run_review_runner() default impl + select_review_runner() factory. Mints adversarial_judgment + evidence_judgment envelopes; defensive gaps_open on no-judge-response (fail-closed); artifact_mismatch verdict on bound-triple hash drift (R-B3); 5-value verdict enum gates auto_merge_runner.

convergence_runner + review_runner REQUIRED kwargs (Tier-1, no default, no Optional annotation per V3 §A1 precedent). Gate A injected between bridge_drained and worker_drainer; non-converged verdicts skip worker_drainer + auto_merge_runner; reflection still runs (V3.3 §2b preserved). Gate B injected between worker_dispatch_drained and auto_merge_runner; auto_merge gated by LITERAL predicate `if review_result["review_verdict"] == "no_gaps":` (I-V5.2-04 source-substring invariant). Reflection v2 kwargs (convergence_result + review_result + pedagogy_lint_result) inject into both post-drain reflection calls so daily report covers full cycle outcome.

Regex-based imperative detector (case-sensitive uppercase, frontmatter-skip, fence-aware, <!-- pedagogy-skip --> opt-out) + per-tier pairing rule + grandfather allowlist + CLI exit code + structured JSON output. Tier-1 imperative-only allowed (consequence-leak-allowlist class), Tier-2 hybrid (≥1 narrative), Tier-3 narrative (Example/code-block REQUIRED — operator 'orneklerle' plural-mandatory). V4 narrative shape accepted alongside V5 for backward compat.

72 newly-tiered agents (~8 Tier-1 / ~49 Tier-2 / ~15 Tier-3 default classification). 81 total agents now registered in _pedagogy-registry.json (V4's 9 + V5.3's 72). tests/invariants/agent-pedagogy.allowlist.json carries 80 entries (72 newly-tiered + 8 V4 ARIA agents with V5-strictness gap); 30-day expiry per entry; entries force-clear after expiry.

Pedagogy lint step added to aria-kernel.yml + aria-kernel-fast.yml + aria-kernel-full.yml — warn mode (allowlist respected); 30-day expiry serves as automatic forcing function for editorial follow-up. --strict flip is a separate commit once allowlist is empty.
